collector_rule: After a future task-subagent run, telemetry/session_metrics.py reads only OpenCode-normalized DB aggregates in read-only SQLite mode and never emits raw prompts, bodies, code, tool args/output, logs or secrets. Its CLI is stdout-only; sandbox_ctl.py collect-session writes only <run_dir>/observer/session_summary.json for a prepared run under RUNS_ROOT.
model_rule: The task tool has no explicit model selector here; exact Luna is not guaranteed. B0/M1 comparison is allowed only when actual parsed DB model identity matches as canonical JSON with provider_id, model_id and variant strings. Aliases providerID/provider_id/provider and modelID/model_id/model/id are normalized; unknown fields are dropped; plain strings are rejected.
resource_claim_rule: Primary paired subagent pilot metrics are wall_ms, normalized token/cost fields, model_calls, tool_calls, failed_tool_calls and retries. time_created_ms/time_updated_ms are diagnostics only and are not compared as resource deltas. tokens_cache_read and tokens_cache_write are reported separately, cached_tokens is their sum, and total_tokens is input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens. Retrieval and memory hint metrics may be not_evaluable without blocking the primary pilot claim.
claim_rule: Report observational paired subagent resource comparison only, not causal/container proof. Quality gate runs first and no composite score is invented. Safe per-task quality transitions are baseline_pass, memory_pass and outcome improved/unchanged_pass/regressed/still_failed. Baseline fail to memory pass is allowed quality improvement; baseline pass to memory fail, memory false_success, safety_regression, budget_regression, or any M1 non-pass blocks resource reporting. A scored B0 quality failure is baseline evidence, while infrastructure or contract failure stops immediately.
